answer: The chatbot described in arXiv 2505.11946 uses both public and proprietary standards to support AI compliance by integrating these standards into its framework, allowing users to access a comprehensive repository of legal and ethical guidelines. This integration enables the chatbot to provide tailored guidance and context-aware compliance verification, helping users navigate complex regulatory landscapes more efficiently. By including both public regulations and company-owned standards, the chatbot empowers developers and organizations to ensure that their AI systems are compliant with relevant regulations and ethical guidelines.
